definitionZh: 字段缩放的 CSS 属性使您能够控制给定默认首选大小的元素的缩放行为,例如窗体控制元素. 此属性使您能够覆盖默认的大小行为, 允许格式控制调整大小以适应其内容 。
sourceDefinition: The field-sizing CSS property enables you to control the sizing behavior of elements that are given a default preferred size, such as form control elements. This property enables you to override the default sizing behavior, allowing form controls to adjust in size to fit their contents.
